description:
Powerful 36V 250W Rear Hub Motor

Equipped with a high-efficiency 250W rear geared hub motor delivering up to 42Nm torque, this electric cargo bike provides smooth acceleration and reliable performance for daily commuting, cargo transport, and urban riding.

Long-Range 36V 13Ah Removable Battery

The high-capacity lithium battery offers extended riding range per charge, making it ideal for commuting, delivery tasks, and long city rides. The removable design allows convenient indoor charging.

Front & Rear Cargo Racks for Maximum Utility

Built with durable steel front and rear cargo racks, this e-bike is designed for carrying groceries, work gear, parcels, or travel essentials, making it a practical solution for urban logistics and family use.

7-Speed Shimano-Style Gear System for Versatility

The 7-speed drivetrain ensures smooth gear shifting across different terrains, providing efficient pedaling whether climbing hills, riding flat city roads, or carrying heavy loads.

Stable Fat Tyres & Comfort-Oriented Design

Featuring wide 3.0-inch tyres and a reinforced frame, the bike delivers enhanced grip, stability, and shock absorption. Designed for confident riding on urban streets and light off-road paths with a max assist speed of 25 km/h (EU compliant).

ANT-A8 is a cargo electric bike designed by Hiland for urban commuters and leisure riders. With its beautiful appearance, strong and durable power and professional drivetrain, it is both aesthetic and practical. Perfectly combining efficiency and style, it is an ideal choice for daily commuting, leisure riding and shopping. ANT-A8 assists you in saying goodbye to bulky bags and allows you to enjoy the freedom of hassle-free transport.
